first_setup.title: Set Up BRUH Claude
first_setup.description:
This creates:
- A **conversation agent** that appears in Settings > Voice Assistants
- **Usage limit sensors** that track your Anthropic account usage

You can add more agents with different personalities later using the **Add Service** button.

data_description.name: This name appears in Voice Assistants and on the Devices page.

add_agent.title: Add Another Agent
add_agent.description:
Create a new conversation agent with its own personality. Each agent gets its own model, system prompt, and timeout.

**Usage sensors are shared** — they're account-wide and already set up.

data_description.name: A unique name for this agent (e.g. 'Sarcastic Claude', 'Kitchen Assistant').
data_description.model: Which Claude model this agent uses. Sonnet is fast and balanced, Opus is the most capable, Haiku is the fastest and cheapest.
data_description.system_prompt: Instructions that define this agent's personality and behavior. Leave blank for the default assistant.
data_description.timeout: Maximum time in seconds to wait for Claude to respond.

hassio_confirm.title: BRUH Claude Discovered
hassio_confirm.description:
The BRUH Claude Terminal add-on has been detected. Click Submit to create a conversation agent and usage limit sensors.

You can add more agents with different personalities later from the integration page.

error.addon_not_running: The BRUH Claude Terminal add-on does not appear to be running. Start the add-on and try again.
error.no_features: Please enable at least one feature.

abort.already_configured: BRUH Claude is already configured. You can add more conversation agents from the integration page using 'Add Service'.

init.title: Configure Agent
init.description:
**Agent Settings** control how this conversation agent behaves.
**Feature Toggles** control what this config entry provides.

data_description.enable_conversation: When disabled, this agent will not appear in Voice Assistants.
data_description.enable_sensors: Create sensors that track your Anthropic account usage limits. This is account-wide (not per agent).
data_description.model: Which Claude model this agent uses. Sonnet is fast and balanced, Opus is the most capable, Haiku is the fastest and cheapest.
data_description.system_prompt: A system prompt that defines this agent's personality. Leave blank for the default assistant behavior.
data_description.timeout: Maximum time in seconds to wait for Claude to respond.

error.no_features: Please enable at least one feature.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description:
The BRUH Claude integration has been updated to version {version}. Home Assistant will restart to load the new version.

This will briefly interrupt all automations and connections.
